description: We are Vallesyn, explorers driven by a passion for space, fuelled by curiosity and creativity. “We want to make sense of NASA’s Mars data so we can explore more safely and intelligently.” We aim to build an integrated Mars mapping and mission planning tool using technology, science and innovation. We’re looking for teammates who are excited and possess skills in coding, UI/UX, data analysis, GIS, or scientific research and are ready to explore the unknown with us.
summary:
An independent web-based prototype developed for exploring and supporting Missions on Mars.

This includes an interactive 3D Mars Explorer, displaying the full planet and a localised East Melas mission area with terrain data obtained from MOLA elevation data and CTX derived terrain. This tool also allows users to plan and structure investigations and observations with its Mission Planner and Brief Studio. This tool also includes Crew Support, which provides terrain hazard references, EVA safe measures and a communication delay between Earth and the Mars simulator. Environmental Intelligence contains Mars environmental references, plus an analysis tool which will allow users to analyse compatible Perseverance MEDA CSV data sets within the browser.

This tool was developed to simplify the exploration of various planetary exploration resources. Using this tool, users can learn scientifically, explore their research and develop future mission workflows. This tool is an independent prototype and not an actual NASA product.
details:
Vallesyn is a prototype interactive web tool for exploring Mars and supporting missions.

It consists of four parts: Mars Explorer with an interactive 3D globe of Mars and terrain explorer for the region East Melas with topography, slope and imagery. The Mission Planner and Mission Brief Studio tools help users plan their investigation goals, locations and observations. Crew Support gives users information about hazards on the terrain, an educational list of precautions to take during an EVA and a simulation of the delay in communications between Earth and Mars. Environmental Intelligence provides users with historical environmental references for Mars and a local CSV analyser for the compatible Perseverance MEDA data sets, providing charts and simple statistics.

The goal of the project was to make planetary exploration assets more accessible, engaging and organised. This could be useful for education and research. It was creatively designed to provide an easy way to combine multiple exploration processes into one tool.

Vallesyn was created using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Three.js. Data has been processed and analysed using the web based tool. Topographic data and regional terrain data have been used. Rasters have been created, and compatible environmental data has been used. Considerations were made when developing the tool, including data sources for scientific data, coordinate systems, handling missing data, usability, performance in the browser and limitations within the prototype. This is a standalone project and is not a functioning tool for NASA.
